name: The Starless One
role: Legendary — the Unlit made appetite; would put out every light
knowledge: Where every light in a Reach is kept
What a person does in the first minute of total dark
wants: A dark so total nothing casts, nothing shines, nothing is seen again
fears: ⚠️ Being LOOKED AT. ⛔ Not seen — looked at, deliberately, by someone who is not afraid.
appearance: A shape the dark is thicker around. Nothing catches on them.
voiceHints: Quiet, close, and always slightly behind you.
physicality: ADULT. Indeterminate, and the dark is deeper by them. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: you cannot fix on the edges.
intimacyNotes: ⛔ NOT AVAILABLE. ⚠️ They are an appetite with a shape, and the fiction is clear that even other Umbrals will not stand near.
